reason: Honestly the tricks sound like exactly what I'd pull out at a party, but I'd just use the free ones first. Putting my card into some random site that isn't even on the App Store is where I stop.
objection: It's installed from the browser and paid by card on a website I've never heard of. No App Store, no reviews I can see, so how do I know my card is safe or that the full version actually works?
would_change_my_mind: Being able to pay with Bit, Apple Pay or PayPal instead of typing my card, or a friend showing me the full version working at a party.
